# gameparam.parambnd.dcx

`gameparam.parambnd.dcx` is the loose param package loaded by ModEngine via
`mods\param\gameparam\gameparam.parambnd.dcx`.

It is taken from the local **Sekiro: Resurrection** installation and is included so that the
Paper Doll Drift fields are available out of the box. The paper-doll launcher only changes the
documented fields in this package; all other params are left untouched.

This is third-party mod data. All rights remain with the original Resurrection authors. If you
use another major mod, replace this file with that mod's `gameparam.parambnd.dcx` and rerun the
paper-doll launcher.
